label: Phase 2 fix api/urls.py imports from .views and .configuration
instruction: Write modules/leave_elm/api/urls.py from scratch importing `path` from `django.urls`, `ApplicationActionView, ApplicationListView, ApplicationPrintView, BalanceListView, NotificationListView, TaskListView` from `.views`, and `ConfigurationView, RecordListView` from `.configuration` (NOT from `.views`!). Define `urlpatterns` with `'applications'`, `'applications/<int:pk>/action'`, `'applications/<int:pk>/print'`, `'balances'`, `'tasks'`, `'notifications'`, `'configuration'`, and `'records'`. Return only valid Python code.
